acceptance: Start from current origin/dev. PR #4442 heads e89d09ea, 67e8ce11, 1041551b, 85b4d860, 5b2c309e, and 69e69ffa are rejected evidence only and must not enter ancestry.

Instrument every record_task_failure_streak path, including immediate start failure, active worker failure, and boot reconciliation, with exact task id, logical provider, canonical owner-at-failure, independent reviewer-at-failure, normalized failure kind and reason class, count, full-precision failure timestamp, durable failure evidence identity/raw_ref, exact rejected/current 40-hex head when known, and a stable unique failure generation.
Do not read mutable generic task.last_update as identity or progress. Do not mutate canonical task state from the failure recorder.

The v3 decoder must fail closed when version, task, provider, owner, independent reviewer, kind, reason class, timestamp, count, generation, or durable failure evidence identity is missing or malformed. A missing rejected-head baseline must be explicit and may never allow a commit-based recovery later.

Generation identity must remain immutable for one recorded failure and must not collide after a record is cleared/recreated in the same second. Derive it from immutable failure fields/evidence rather than timestamp seconds alone.

Add deterministic tests using captured real request_snapshot/worker shapes for each failure call site, owner/reviewer propagation, logical provider slots, raw_ref identity, rejected-head capture, generation immutability/uniqueness, missing-field legacy records, malformed timestamps/heads, and unrelated streak preservation.
